title: N -W F P Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Civil Servants Second Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 19th October, 2001]
No. Legis.1(21)73-II/6622-27.,
dated 19-10-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title and
commencement,---(1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Civil Servants (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE CIVIL SERVANTS
(SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF
2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 19th October, 2001]
No. Legis.1(21)73-II/6622-27.,
dated 19-10-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 13 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No. XVIII of 1973.---In the North-West Frontier Province
Civil Servants Act, 1973 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. XVIII of 1973), in section 13, in
subsection (1), in clause (a), for the word "twenty-five", the word
"twenty" shall be substituted.
